## Modules

- [ExLibSRTP](https://ex-libsrtp.hexdocs.pm/ExLibSRTP.md): [libsrtp](https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp) bindings for Elixir.
- [ExLibSRTP.MasterKey](https://ex-libsrtp.hexdocs.pm/ExLibSRTP.MasterKey.md): Struct containing SRTP master key and its identifier.

- [ExLibSRTP.Policy](https://ex-libsrtp.hexdocs.pm/ExLibSRTP.Policy.md): Policy for setting up SRTP stream configuration.
